title: process.json of an agent run
description: The process of a role (<item>/agents/<id>/process.json, process.py run_role), written right after it started; cold recovery (application/recovery.py) stops an orphaned group only when the pid, the group and the start ticks still name the same process.

pgid.description: Process group of the role (its own session: the pid).

start_ticks.description: Start time of the process in clock ticks since boot (/proc/<pid>/stat), null when it could not be read.
